core_question: Was life arbitrarily deprived or insufficiently protected?
typical_issues: death penalty, police force, armed operations, disappearances, preventable death, investigation duties

core_question: Was treatment absolute prohibited torture or cruel, inhuman, or degrading treatment?
typical_issues: detention abuse, interrogation, refoulement, medical abuse, prison conditions

core_question: Was detention lawful, non-arbitrary, reviewed, and challengeable?
typical_issues: pretrial detention, immigration detention, security detention, habeas review, arbitrary arrest

core_question: Was the person tried by a competent, independent, impartial tribunal with due process?
typical_issues: military courts, secret evidence, counsel access, presumption of innocence, appeal

core_question: Was interference with privacy, family, home, or correspondence arbitrary or unlawful?
typical_issues: surveillance, data collection, searches, family separation, digital privacy

core_question: Was any restriction lawful, legitimate, necessary, and proportionate?
typical_issues: censorship, journalism, online speech, national security, misinformation laws

core_question: Were restrictions on protest or association justified under strict limitation tests?
typical_issues: protest bans, union restrictions, NGO laws, police dispersal, public order

core_question: Were citizens able to participate genuinely and equally in public affairs?
typical_issues: elections, candidate bans, voting rights, disenfranchisement, political parties

core_question: Were rights enjoyed without discrimination and were minority cultural rights respected?
typical_issues: racial discrimination, gender inequality, religious minorities, language rights, Indigenous communities
